Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.hourglass/gaps.py:
# owner: platform
"""Stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.parsing import format_span

# ---
def gap_labels(
    worked: Iterable[Span],
    opening: Span
) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch of opening hours.

    ValueError when a worked span is outside opening hours.
    """
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    for span in merged:
        early = span.start < opening.start
        late = span.end > opening.end
        if early or late:
            text = f"{format_span(span)} is outside hours"
            raise ValueError(text)

    stretches = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in merged:
        if span.start > cursor:
            stretches.append(Span(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        stretches.append(Span(cursor, opening.end))
    labels = []
    for stretch in stretches:
        text = format_span(stretch)
        labels.append(f"gap {text} ({stretch.minutes} min)")
    return labels
after.tests/test_gaps.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.gaps import gap_labels
from hourglass.models import Span

OPENING = Span(540, 1020)

class GapLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nobody_working_is_one_gap(self):
        expected = ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"]
        labels = gap_labels([], OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_fully_covered_has_no_gaps(self):
        labels = gap_labels([OPENING], OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, [])

    def test_lunch_gap_between_two_shifts(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(780, 1020)]
        expected = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        worked = [Span(600, 900)]
        expected = [
            "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
            "gap 15:00-17:00 (120 min)"
        ]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_overlapping_workers_do_not_split_a_gap(self):
        worked = [
            Span(540, 700),
            Span(680, 720),
            Span(780, 1020)
        ]
        expected = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, expected)

    def test_touching_shifts_leave_no_gap(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(720, 1020)]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, OPENING)
        self.assertEqual(labels, [])

    def test_work_before_opening_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gap_labels([Span(480, 600)], OPENING)

    def test_work_after_closing_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            gap_labels([Span(900, 1080)], OPENING)
